The runbook’s Detail no longer fits the installed build tool, but the Pattern still governs: a reproducible bundle matching CI’s tested hash. I’ll check the build script, tool version, and CI command before changing the procedure or implementation, so we can choose the smallest reversible fix that actually preserves that aim.

TOOL: git status --short && cat package.json && printf '
--- lockfile/build-tool references ---
' && rg -n 'legacy-bundler|bundler=classic|npm run build|build #' .github docs package.json package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock 2>/dev/null | head -200 && printf '
--- files ---
' && ls
